name: Anhui Transport Consulting & Design Institute Co.,Ltd.
summary: Anhui Transport Consulting & Design Institute Co., Ltd., along with its subsidiaries, specializes in offering comprehensive engineering survey, design, and advisory services to clients both in China and worldwide. The company provides expertise across a wide array of infrastructure and development sectors, including road networks, waterborne transportation, municipal infrastructure, building construction, water resource management, ecological and territorial remediation, and landscape planning. Furthermore, its specialized services extend to encompass transportation strategic planning, soil and water conservation, environmental impact assessments, urban development schemes, and geological disaster evaluations. Established in 1960, the firm's main operational base is located in Hefei, People's Republic of China.
